findings.evidence: 열심히 하다 보니까 성공하게/시작하게/실패하게 됐어요 can all describe an outcome.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 성공하다 against 시작하다 and 실패하다.

findings.evidence: 한번 도전해/시작해 보기로 했어요 are equally natural.
포기하지/실패하지/시작하지 않기로 했어요 are all natural decisions.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 포기하다 against 실패하다 and 시작하다.

findings.evidence: 수입/사업이 줄어들까 봐 걱정이에요 are both plausible.
내년에 퇴직하게/시작하게/실패하게 될 것 같아요 are all plausible without an object.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 퇴직하다 against 시작하다 and 실패하다.

findings.evidence: The note labels 지다 → 질까 봐 as ‘ㄹ irregular’; 지다 is a regular vowel-final stem that simply takes ㄹ까 봐.
findings.fix: Applied note correction to the regular vowel-stem rule.

findings.evidence: 일을 하다 보니까 인맥/사업/걱정이 생기게 됐어요 are all natural outcomes.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 인맥 against 사업 and 걱정.
